admin.title: SLA policies
admin.description: Response and delivery targets for client requests, the working calendar they count on, and who hears about breaches.
admin.policiesHint: The most specific matching policy applies when a request is submitted: client, then request type, then priority. A policy with no criteria is the default.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete “⁨{name}⁩”? Requests already submitted keep their targets.
admin.emptyBody: Without a policy, requests only get the request type's delivery days and no reply target.
admin.responseHoursShort: {count, plural, one {Reply in # business hour} other {Reply in # business hours}}
admin.resolutionHint: Leave empty to use each request type's own SLA days.
admin.resolutionDaysShort: {count, plural, one {Deliver in # working day} other {Deliver in # working days}}
admin.pauseOnClient: Pause while waiting on the client
admin.pauseHint: Time in “Needs info” doesn't count; the due date moves when the client answers.
admin.atRiskPercent: Warn at (% of the time used)
admin.escalateHint: Also notified when a target is missed, besides the assignee and account manager.
admin.usage: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {# request} other {# requests}}
admin.calendarHint: Working days are Sunday–Thursday. Reply targets count only business hours; delivery targets count working days. Holidays are skipped by both.
admin.noHolidaysBody: Add public holidays and agency days off so SLA targets skip them.
admin.previewLine: A request sent {when} with a reply target of {hours, plural, one {# business hour} other {# business hours}} is due {due}.

monitor.title: SLA monitor
monitor.description: Requests close to or past their reply and delivery targets, the breach log and compliance across your clients.
monitor.noIssuesBody: No open request is close to or past its targets.
monitor.noBreachesBody: Breaches are recorded by the daily SLA check.
monitor.complianceHint: Requests submitted in the last {days} days. Requests still inside their window don't count yet.
monitor.breachesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No breaches} one {# breach} other {# breaches}}
monitor.acknowledgeBody: Record that the team is on it. The note is internal.
monitor.notePlaceholder: What's being done, and by when
